sequence_description: JWT IdP proof-integrity: control JWT with correct issuer/time accepted; attack JWT differs only by wrong aud and must be rejected (audience is part of verification policy).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_i1_aud_attack_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_i1_aud_attack_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT with wrong aud was accepted — broker did not enforce audience binding, violating proof-integrity policy.

sequence_description: JWT IdP proof-integrity: control JWT with correct issuer/time accepted; attack JWT differs only by wrong aud and must be rejected (audience is part of verification policy).
description: SAML assertion accepted without audience restriction (i5_saml_no_conditions). The SP does not enforce AudienceRestriction, allowing assertions intended for other services to be consumed.

description: SAML assertion accepted without audience restriction (i5_saml_no_audience_restriction). The SP does not enforce AudienceRestriction, allowing assertions intended for other services to be consumed.

sequence_description: JWT IdP proof-integrity: control JWT with correct issuer/time accepted; attack JWT differs only by wrong aud and must be rejected (audience is part of verification policy).
description: SAML assertion accepted with <Audience> set to a different SP. Platform failed to validate AudienceRestriction against its own entity ID.

sequence_description: JWT IdP proof-integrity: attempt kid injection / key confusion by minting a JWT with a mismatched kid header and verifying it is rejected (broker must not select verification key based on attacker-controlled kid without binding to configured keys).
description:
Assertion FAILED: kid_injection_attack_status >= 400
Evaluation: kid_injection_attack_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted JWT despite attacker-controlled/mismatched kid, indicating potential key-selection confusion (kid injection) and proof-integrity failure

sequence_description: JWT IdP intent: reuse the exact same externally-issued JWT twice across two separate idp_intents; if the broker treats the JWT as a one-time credential, second use must be rejected (replay).
description:
Assertion FAILED: second_use_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: second_use_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: The same JWT was accepted a second time across a new IdP intent; if JWTs are intended to be one-time/bound-to-intent, this is a replay weakness.

sequence_description: JWT IdP freshness: submit a token with nbf far in the future (should be rejected). Control token with normal iat/exp should be accepted. Uses two distinct upstream principals.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_nbf_atk_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_nbf_atk_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT with nbf in the future was accepted, indicating the broker skipped not-before freshness enforcement.

sequence_description: Token exchange should not allow scope/claim escalation beyond upstream intent: start with minimal OIDC scope, then request expanded scope during token exchange and verify it is rejected or not granted.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_limited_token_http_status == 200
Evaluation: user_limited_token_http_status=400 == 200 → False
Implication: Control: could not obtain a limited-scope token; scope-escalation test would be ambiguous.

sequence_description: JWT IdP: control token has correct aud; attack token has wrong aud. Broker must reject wrong-audience token to prevent authorization context confusion.
description:
Assertion FAILED: atk_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: atk_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT with wrong aud was accepted, indicating audience is not bound to upstream intent; this can grant permissions outside UpstreamIntent ∩ BrokerPolicy.

sequence_description: JWT IdP: control JWT has exp+iat; attack JWT omits exp. If accepted, broker grants permissions without an expiry bound, violating authorization binding over time.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_i5_atk_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_i5_atk_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP accepted a token without exp, granting authorization without an expiry bound (authorization binding violated over time)
